decisions.rationale: Freeze requires exact repository, 40-hex commit, path, line range and Git blob and records whole-blob SHA-256; import independently re-resolves and verifies before claim identity/materialization.

decisions.decision: Keep the first corpus to two literal records, one changelog and one specification_history.
decisions.rationale: This is the minimum Phase-6 vertical slice and avoids an all-document importer or LLM interpretation as deterministic truth.

decisions.decision: Delegate claim identity, relation invariants, duplicate checks and canonical bytes to the merged historical claim contract.
decisions.rationale: This preserves hwm-historical-claim/v1 and hwm-historical-conflicts/v1 exactly and never serializes historical knowledge as hwm-claim/v1.

decisions.decision: Expose only the trusted historical-ledger publication request shape; no direct Git mutation exists in the importer.
decisions.rationale: hwm-context publication remains exclusively behind the completed Issue #37 repository-local publisher and protected PR/bootstrap path.
